sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Aching, especially in occiput — pulsating and
ringing in ears. Pain in zygoma; face pale.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Loss of appetite, thirsty, craves wine and
coffee ; bloated, sore pain in stomach rising toward

sections.label: Urine
sections.text:
Scanty, with phosphates, sugar or albumen.

Sexual. — Male power lost or enfeebled. Anaphro-
disia and ovarian insufficiency.

' Extremities. — Soreness, aching, lack of energy.
Tired and weak.
